approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Measures No. 1) Bill 2017

Labor supported the Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Measures No. 1) Bill 2017, which makes technical corrections to allow investors via interposed trusts to access capital gains concessions for start-ups and allows ASIC to share confidential information with the Tax Commissioner more easily.

The bill supports innovation by improving access to capital for startups, but the speaker warned that an ATO alert on the R&D tax incentive could restrict software development eligibility and harm digital startups, citing StartupAUS CEO Alex McCauley.
